scope: Five retained Profile migration-owned tables plus same-snapshot derived identities, text and media. Local reader proof only; no remote handle/job/global inventory acceptance.

profile.fieldEncoding: SQL-bounded prefixes/length metadata; large strings in ordered code-point chunks; exact SQL timestamp text; inline PNG/JPEG as decoded base64 byte chunks with SHA-256; original headers retained. Unsupported role/media values fail capture.
profile.relationship: timeLineEvents represented by account-owned Timeline rows, not eager relations

timeline.relatedProfileId: Owned reference retained; foreign reference explicitly redacted without UUID
timeline.relatedGoalIdAndRelatedProjectId: Null preserved; owned target IDs included as typed references after ownership joins; foreign target IDs redacted.
timeline.timestamp: Exact SQL timestamp text, including microseconds; no inferred host timezone

guardian_profile_activity.verification: Exactly one role and profile owner matches dependent; operation allowlist; dependent array bounded before driver read; all retained rows, no preview row cap

goal.fieldEncoding: Complete text inline or bounded ordered Unicode chunks; exact SQL timestamps/microseconds/nulls and stored integers. References include only verified owned IDs; foreign references explicitly redacted.

project.fieldEncoding: Complete text inline or bounded ordered Unicode chunks; exact SQL timestamp. References include only verified owned IDs; foreign references explicitly redacted. Circular references do not trigger eager traversal.

legacyStores.goal: Export adapter integrated in same capture snapshot
legacyStores.project: Export adapter integrated in same capture snapshot
legacyStores.guard: Temporary unsupported-data guard removed only after adapters and actual PG proof

media: Strict canonical base64 and PNG/JPEG signatures, decoded-byte counts/hash. External/asset/opaque references preserved without fetching; no Assets/Videos byte coverage or full image-codec validation claimed.
